title: 49ers GM John Lynch: I don't know if we can afford Joey Bosa

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers GM John Lynch: I don't know if we can afford Joey Bosa
sources.description: The 49ers hope to have Nick Bosa back in action during training camp, but it doesn't sound like anyone should bank on him sharing a locker room with his brother.
